checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Face, expression and features closely match the source.
Same hair, ribbed sweater (now pinkish) and composition.
Trees, path, bench and lawn remain, though recoloured to autumn orange.

must.item: Warm faded grading with visible grain, 1970s look
must.why: Warm amber with grain and vignette; somewhat oversaturated and heavy, more like a lomo/cross-process look than faded.

faults.what: Colour grade is too intense and saturated orange/red, with a glowing hotspot at top, rather than subtly faded; green park turned to autumn tones and sweater tinted pink
Grey sweater and skin tone shifted noticeably; hair lost some detail in dark shadows

summary: A square, text-free, recognisable retro-styled portrait with warm grain and the park intact, though the orange grade is stronger and more saturated than a faded 1970s look.
